sheets.title: An empty name, desktop — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Saving a new item with no name. Before, a red box opens in the middle of the editor and interrupts it to narrate one failed field. After, the editor is untouched and the bell takes the notice: the failure is announced and read in the notifications tray, where it can be dismissed, and it is not lost when the person moves on.
sheets.before: red alert box in the editor
sheets.after: no box · bell carries the notice

sheets.title: The same failure in the tray — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The bell opened. Before, the tray was empty and the failure lived only in the page. After, the tray holds the sentence as its own card, with a dismiss key.

sheets.title: An empty name, phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The same failure on a phone, where the box cost a band of the 844px screen and pushed the form down. The editor keeps its height; the More key carries the attention dot.
sheets.before: red alert box in the editor
sheets.after: no box · More key carries the dot

sheets.title: The same failure in the tray — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Notifications opened from the More sheet, which is where a phone keeps the bell.
